rationale: Material prompt requirement: Write a declarative mobile UI test for a desktop-style context action: focus a list row with a keyboard, open its context menu with a secondary pointer action, select “Rename”, type a new label, and assert the updated row after the UI becomes idle.. Comparing the complete source-visible workflow with the prompt: It directly supports declarative Jetpack Compose UI testing with stable node selectors, keyboard and pointer interactions, context menus, text entry, recomposition-aware assertions, and verification checklists.
